title: Receiving Tolerance Share by Shipment Line Size, FBN
content:
The tolerance share in the receiving tolerance of a Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) inbound shipment line is the large-line tolerance share of 1% (0.01) for a line with at least the large-line threshold of 200 units expected, and nothing (0) for a line with fewer than the small-line threshold of 50 units expected. A line with at least 50 but fewer than 200 units expected is not altered by this schedule.

The units expected are those declared on the shipment plan for the claimed line, as recorded on its inbound receipt.

| Units expected on the line | Tolerance share |
|---|---|
| 49 or fewer | nothing (0) |
| 50 to 199 | not altered by this schedule |
| 200 or more | 1% |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical lines)

| Units expected | Tolerance share |
|---|---|
| 49 | nothing (0) |
| 50 | not altered by this schedule |
| 199 | not altered by this schedule |
| 200 | 1% |
| 650 | 1% |
